![Graph of f(x) = x^z where z >= 2 and < 3](y_raised_2_to_2.9.png)

This is $f(x) = x^z \text{ for } z \in [2,3)$, with the function collapsing into an apparent single line for $x < 0$ and non-integer values of $z$ where the function is in the domain of complex numbers (real and imaginary parts).
